name: (Ricardo) Tag Zoom meeting attendance by engagement thresholds in KlickTipp

parameters.content:
Community Node Disclaimer: This workflow uses KlickTipp community nodes.


### Introduction
This workflow automates the end-to-end integration between Zoom and KlickTipp using n8n. It listens to Zoom meeting events (specifically, when a meeting ends), fetches all participants and registrants, and gives every person exactly one attendance result in KlickTipp: attended (optionally fully attended) or not attended. This enables precise segmentation for follow-ups and campaign automation based on actual user engagement.

### Benefits
- **Fully automated tagging**: No manual effort—participants and no-shows are tagged in KlickTipp automatically after every meeting.
- **Complete segmentation**: Every registrant ends up in exactly one segment—attended, fully attended or not attended. Nobody falls through the gaps.
- **Safe for existing contacts**: Existing KlickTipp contacts only receive tags; names and subscription status stay untouched.
- **Multi-meeting support**: Handles any number of meetings (e.g. Beginner vs. Expert) via one configuration list.

### Key Features
- **Zoom Webhook Listener**:
  - Reacts to `meeting.ended` events.
  - Validates Zoom URL on webhook registration using HMAC.
  - Answers Zoom immediately and waits 60 seconds before fetching data, so the past meeting report is available.
- **Zoom API Integration**:
  - Pulls **all** participants of the past meeting (paginated, `page_size=300`, `next_page_token`).
  - Pulls **all** approved registrants of the meeting (paginated) to identify no-shows.
  - Encodes the meeting UUID as required by Zoom (double encoding for UUIDs starting with `/` or containing `//`).
- **Attendance Logic** (Code node "Aggregate and classify"):
  - Filters out internal users (e.g. the host) and entries without an e-mail address.
  - Resolves missing participant e-mails via `registrant_id`.
  - Merges rejoins of the same person and sums up their durations.
  - Measures attendance against the **actual** meeting length (`end_time - start_time`), fallback: scheduled duration.
  - Classifies each person as attended, fully attended (> 90%) or not attended (registered, never joined).
- **KlickTipp Subscription & Tagging**:
  - Existing contact: adds the attended tag only.
  - New contact: subscribes via the opt-in process with first and last name from Zoom and the attended tag.
  - Adds the full attendance tag above the threshold.
  - Tags registered no-shows as not attended (existing contacts only).
  - Stops visibly on lookup errors other than "contact not found" (e.g. authentication or rate limits).
- **Scalable Structure**:
  - Add more meetings by adding one entry (topic + three tag IDs) to the `WEBINARS` list—no new branches needed.

### Setup Instructions
**Zoom Preparation**
   - Ensure Zoom API access is enabled.
   - Set up meetings or recurring meetings with **registration enabled** (required for the "not attended" result).
   - For recurring meetings, set registration to **"once for all occurrences"** (see Known Limitations).
   - Enable webhook event `meeting.ended` for your Zoom webhook and the scopes `meeting:read:meeting`, `meeting:read:list_past_participants`, `meeting:read:list_registrants`.
   - Enter the **Secret Token** of your Zoom app in the Crypto node.

**KlickTipp Preparation**
   - Manually add the following tags per meeting:
     - `Zoom meeting E-Mail Zustellung für Anfänger attended`
     - `Zoom meeting E-Mail Zustellung für Anfänger attended fully`
     - `Zoom meeting E-Mail Zustellung für Anfänger not attended`
     - `Zoom meeting E-Mail Zustellung für Experten attended`
     - `Zoom meeting E-Mail Zustellung für Experten attended fully`
     - `Zoom meeting E-Mail Zustellung für Experten not attended`
   - Select the opt-in process (`listId`) for new contacts in the node "Subscribe new participant".

**n8n Configuration**
   - Configure the webhook node for the Zoom endpoint and connect it to your webhook.
   - Set up API credentials for Zoom and KlickTipp.
   - Edit the `WEBINARS` list at the top of the Code node "Aggregate and classify": one entry per meeting with a part of the meeting topic and the three tag IDs (`attended`, `full`, `notAttended`). The workflow stops with a clear error message as long as a tag ID is still a placeholder.

### Testing and Deployment
1. Register at least two test contacts for a Zoom meeting connected to the flow.
2. Join with one test contact (once with a rejoin, if possible), leave the other one absent, then end the meeting.
3. Verify:
   - The webhook triggers and the workflow continues after 60 seconds.
   - Participants and registrants are fetched from Zoom.
   - The attending contact receives the attended tag (and the full attendance tag above 90%).
   - The absent contact receives the not attended tag.
   - Existing contacts keep their names; new contacts are created with the Zoom name.

> 💡 *Pro Tip*: Use test emails and simulate different durations (including leaving and rejoining) to validate the attendance logic.

### Known Limitations
- **Recurring meetings with registration per occurrence**: Zoom returns registrants of all occurrences, so registrants of other dates would be tagged as not attended. Use registration "once for all occurrences" or one meeting per date.
- **Meetings without registration**: participants are tagged as usual, but there is no "not attended" result (no registrant list available).
- **Registrants unknown to KlickTipp**: no-shows are only tagged if the contact already exists in KlickTipp.

### Campaign Expansion Ideas
- Trigger personalized follow-up sequences in KlickTipp based on the attendance tags (e.g. replay for no-shows, offer for attendees).
- Combine this workflow with the Zoom registration workflow for full-funnel automation (registration tag, meeting start and join URL).
- Use the full attendance tag to target highly engaged participants with special offers.

### Customization
- Adjust the full attendance threshold via `FULL_ATTENDANCE_RATIO` in the Code node (e.g. 0.8 instead of 0.9).
- Change the wait time after `meeting.ended` if Zoom reports are not yet complete for large meetings.
- Use more granular attendance segments by extending the classification in the Code node (e.g. 0–30%, 30–60%) and adding tag IDs per segment.

nodes.name: Listen to ending Zoom meetings
nodes.notes: This node is listening to Zoom events and triggers when a meeting was ended.

nodes.name: URL Validation check
nodes.notes: Checks whether the call is Zoom's URL validation or a regular event.

nodes.name: Crypto
nodes.notes: Enter the Secret Token of your Zoom app here. Prepares the response for Zoom's URL validation.

nodes.name: Build Validation Body
nodes.notes: Builds the body for Zoom's URL validation.

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook (Validation)
nodes.notes: Sends the validation response back to Zoom.

nodes.name: Build Normal Event Body
nodes.notes: Builds the response body for regular events.

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook (Events)
nodes.notes: Answers Zoom immediately so the webhook does not time out.

nodes.name: Wait 60 seconds
nodes.notes: Gives Zoom time to make the past meeting report available.

nodes.name: Get past Zoom meeting participants
nodes.notes: Loads all participant pages of the past meeting (UUID double-encoded where Zoom requires it).

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const u = $('Listen to ending Zoom meetings').item.json.body.payload.object.uuid; const e = (u.startsWith('/') || u.includes('//')) ? encodeURIComponent(encodeURIComponent(u)) : encodeURIComponent(u); return 'https://api.zoom.us/v2/past_meetings/' + e + '/participants'; })() }}

nodes.name: Get meeting registrants
nodes.notes: Loads all approved registrants (needed for 'not attended'). Meetings without registration return an error, which is ignored.

nodes.name: Aggregate and classify
nodes.notes: CONFIG: meeting topics and tag IDs at the top. Classifies attended / fully attended / not attended.

nodes.name: Attended?
nodes.notes: True: joined the meeting. False: registered but never joined.

nodes.name: Lookup contact in KlickTipp
nodes.notes: Existing contact: only tags are added (no name overwrite). Not found: new contact is subscribed with name.

nodes.name: Tag existing contact as attended
nodes.notes: Existing contact: adds the attended tag, leaves name and subscription untouched.

nodes.name: Contact not found?
nodes.notes: Only the known 'not found' answer creates a new contact; any other lookup error stops visibly.

conditions.rightValue: The resource you are requesting could not be found

nodes.name: Subscribe new participant
nodes.notes: New contact only: subscribed via opt-in process with name from Zoom and the attended tag.

nodes.name: Stop and Error
nodes.notes: Stops visibly for authentication, rate limit or other lookup errors.

parameters.errorMessage: =KlickTipp lookup failed for a reason other than 'not found': {{ $json.error }}

nodes.name: Fully attended?
nodes.notes: True if attended more than 90% of the actual meeting length (rejoins summed).

nodes.name: Tag fully attended
nodes.notes: Adds the full attendance tag.

nodes.name: Tag not attended
nodes.notes: Registered but never joined. Only existing contacts are tagged; registrants unknown to KlickTipp are skipped.
